evidence.quote: The T50-Mox RHEAs samples were fabricated using a 4 kW LAM system (RC-LDM4030, RAYCHAM Laser Technology Group Co., Ltd) with a 3 mm laser beam, operated in an Ar protective atmosphere with an oxygen content of less than 50 ppm.

Based on the previous research results [ 32, 33 ], relevant LAM process parameters were selected: laser power: 1400 W, scanning speed: 10 mm/s, and powder feed rate ranging from 10 g/min to 12.5 g/min, a 3 mm beam diameter.

evidence.section: 4.1. Grain refinement and columnar to equiaxed transformation
evidence.quote: With increasing Mo content, the constitutional supercooling zone ahead of S-L interface increases, promoting the transformation from columnar growth to equiaxed growth, and hence reducing the grain sizes.
